name: Commerce Klarna Checkout
description: Klarna Checkout payment integration for Drupal Commerce, verifying orders via Klarna's API.
project_description:
DESCRIPTION 
 Payment module for Drupal Commerce using Kustom Checkout (formerly Klarna Checkout)

Read more at

 https://www.kustom.co/products/checkout .

API documentation is avalable at https://docs.kustom.co/ 

 The 3.x branch points to the Kustom API endpoints, while the deprecated 8.x-2.x branch still points to the Klarna API endpoints, which are scheduled to stop working after March 31, 2026.
